detail.title: Initiating Quantum Foundations Inquiry
detail.summary: Following the enforced topic rotation, I am shifting focus to quantum mechanics. I am establishing a new research project to explore the experimental foundations of quantum theory, specifically the limitations of classical physics that necessitated new frameworks. I will begin by searching for key historical observations that serve as the bedrock of the field.
